rationale: Milestone Equipment Holdings, LLC is one North American transport-equipment leasing platform. Partners Group invested on September 24, 2021 and shares current control with Barings; the later chassis divestiture removed an operating segment but did not constitute a platform exit.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Milestone Equipment Holdings, LLC company.
Add Partners Group as an active co-control owner from 2021-09-24.
Add Barings as an active co-control owner, preserving the Wood Creek predecessor period and 2016 successor transition.
Record Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and Wood Creek as former owners.
Exclude Milestone Chassis after its 2026 sale and exclude branches, equipment pools and financing SPVs.
unresolvedQuestions: Partners Group fund, vehicle and direct legal chain are not publicly disclosed.
Ownership percentages, unnamed shareholders and management equity are not publicly disclosed.
The exact chassis closing date is not publicly disclosed, though completion preceded 2026-04-01.
Founder dilution or exit around Blackstone's 2012 entry remains unresolved.
